<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/healthz"}
#docs
Always 200 while the process can answer. Point your orchestrator’s LIVENESS probe here, never at /health or /readyz: those check Postgres, so a database blip would be read as every API process being wedged and restart the whole fleet at once.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | Always `ok`. |
| `service` | `string` | The service name. |
| `env` | `string` | The runtime environment. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Process is alive |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/healthz"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "status": "ok",
  "service": "tmbilling-api",
  "env": "production"
}
```
::
